predEngine.errRecencyEmpty: Add at least one recency band.
predEngine.errRecencyOpen: The last recency band must be open-ended (leave its days empty).
predEngine.errRecencyAsc: Recency band days must increase top to bottom.
predEngine.errValueOpen: The last value band must be open-ended (leave its price empty).
predEngine.saved: Engine config saved (v{{v}}). Shadow preview updated.
predEngine.loadFailed: Could not load the engine config.
predEngine.modeShadowTitle: Preview (shadow) mode — live lists are unchanged
predEngine.modeShadowDesc: The current (v3.4) engine still feeds every calling list. Saving here only rebuilds a side-by-side SHADOW preview so you can see exactly what would change before you flip the switch.
predEngine.modeLiveTitle: Live mode — edits change what agents call
predEngine.modeLiveDesc: The config-driven engine is live. Saving re-classifies every customer immediately.
predEngine.recencyTitle: Recency bands (days since last paid order)
predEngine.recencyDesc: How recently they ordered. First matching band wins (top to bottom). The last band must be open-ended. A “holding pen” band (e.g. NEWCOMERS) has no price split and never auto-inherits an agent.
predEngine.label: Label
predEngine.valueTitle: Value brackets (last paid order price, ден)
predEngine.valueDesc: Splits each non-holding-pen band by order price. Last bracket must be open-ended.
predEngine.freqDesc: The most specific tier wins (highest min-orders the customer reaches). Labels are literally true — a “(3+)” list never contains a 2-order customer.
predEngine.reorderDesc: Calls each customer just before they run out of product. Supply = Σ(packages × each product’s days-of-supply). Set per-product days-of-supply on the Products screen (default 15 = a 30-capsule pack; a 4-pack = 60).
predEngine.reorderBuffer: Call this many days BEFORE they run out
predEngine.reorderAgg: When an order has different products
predEngine.reorderAggDesc: Different products are parallel treatments — 2× one + 2× another = 1 month, not 2. Packages of the SAME product still add up.
predEngine.reorderAggLongest: Longest treatment (call when all run out)
predEngine.reorderAggEarliest: Earliest (call when the first runs low)
predEngine.diffTitle: Preview: current lists vs the new engine
predEngine.controlsDesc: Recompute on demand instead of waiting for the nightly 03:00 run, and stop/start the new preview engine whenever you like. The live lists are never affected by stopping the preview.
predEngine.shadowSwitchDesc: Runs the new engine nightly into a side-by-side preview. Turn off to stop all new-engine background work — your live lists keep running untouched.
predEngine.shadowOff: Preview engine stopped. Live lists keep working.

affiliatesAdmin.noAffiliatesDesc: Create the first affiliate to hand out an API key and offers.
affiliatesAdmin.createDesc: Creates the affiliate and generates their S2S API key.
affiliatesAdmin.fieldCodeHint: Short stable ID (a-z, 0-9, dash). Lands in the order source — cannot be renamed later.
affiliatesAdmin.withLoginDesc: Lets them sign in to see offers, stats and postbacks.
affiliatesAdmin.fieldPasswordHint: Minimum 8 characters. Share it with the affiliate over a private channel.
affiliatesAdmin.rotateWarning: The old key stops working immediately. The affiliate must switch to the new key.
affiliatesAdmin.rotateDone: New key generated — copy it now and send it to the affiliate.
affiliatesAdmin.offersDesc: Approve which offers this affiliate may run and override the payout per offer if needed.
affiliatesAdmin.noOffersYet: No offers exist yet — create one in the Offers tab first.
affiliatesAdmin.offerDialogDesc: An offer is what an affiliate can promote: one product, one GEO, one payout.
affiliatesAdmin.fieldProductHint: The catalogue product a lead for this offer turns into.
affiliatesAdmin.sellPriceHint: Leave empty to use the product's own price
affiliatesAdmin.fieldTermsHint: Traffic rules, caps, restrictions the affiliate must follow.
affiliatesAdmin.noOffersDesc: Create an offer, then approve it for your affiliates.
affiliatesAdmin.noPostbacksDesc: Rows appear here when affiliate leads change stage.
affiliatesAdmin.noLeadsRangeDesc: Change the range, stage or affiliate to see leads.

affiliate.noLeadsDesc: Send your first lead through the API — it will show up here instantly.
affiliate.noOffersDesc: Ask your manager to approve offers for your account.
affiliate.apiKeyDesc: Send leads server-to-server with this key. Keep it secret — rotate it if it ever leaks.
affiliate.postbackDesc: We call your tracker URL on every stage change. Use the macros below.
affiliate.snippetsDesc: Copy-paste with your real key and first offer already filled in.
affiliate.macrosDesc: Placeholders replaced in your URL on every postback.
affiliate.macroSubid: Your click ID (falls back to sub1) — for Keitaro use subid={subid}
affiliate.macroStage: Our stage: lead, hold, approve, cancel, trash, return
affiliate.macroCash: Payout in EUR — non-zero only when the order is paid (buyout)
affiliate.macroHold: Payout on hold — non-zero while waiting/approved
affiliate.macroId: Your lead ID (ext_id), falls back to our order ID
affiliate.macroCustom: Custom stage mapping — your six values in order lead|hold|approve|cancel|trash|return
affiliate.rotateWarning: The old key stops working immediately — update your sender right after.
affiliate.rotateDone: New key generated — copy it now and update your integration.
affiliate.passwordDesc: Set your own password. You'll use it the next time you log in.

altercpa.accountsHint: Each account is one AlterCPA install we pull leads from. Nothing is ever sent back.
altercpa.noAccountsHint: Add one to start mirroring leads. You will need the merchant token stored as a function secret first.
altercpa.noTokenHint: The secret {{name}} is not set on this project, so this account cannot fetch anything. Set it with: supabase secrets set {{name}}=…
altercpa.tokenSecretHint: The NAME of a Supabase function secret, never the token itself.
altercpa.callableGeosHint: Comma-separated. These geos become real orders and are called. Every other country is mirrored for reporting only.
altercpa.syncFromHint: A backfill will not reach further back than this date.
altercpa.mirrorHint_off: Once a lead is mirrored, its status here is ours alone. The 5-minute status sync skips this account entirely.
altercpa.mirrorHint_until_touched: AlterCPA outcomes apply only while nobody here has worked the order — this is what the 5-minute status sync (07:00–21:00) runs on. After an agent takes or confirms it, their changes are recorded as a note instead of overwriting the work.
altercpa.mirrorHint_always: AlterCPA is the source of truth. Their outcome overwrites ours even mid-call — use only when nobody here works these leads.
altercpa.dryRunDone: Dry run finished — nothing was written
altercpa.syncSummary: {{fetched}} fetched · {{created}} new orders · {{ledger}} new in the ledger
altercpa.noLeadsHint: Try widening the filters, or run a sync to pull the latest.
altercpa.queueHint: A lead whose offer we do not recognise is still mirrored, but it does not become an order until you say which product it is. Importing it with no product would hide it from every product and stock report.
altercpa.queueAllClearHint: New offer names appear here automatically the first time AlterCPA sends one.
altercpa.runsHint: Every sync, with what it fetched and what it skipped.
altercpa.runsFailedHint: A run failed. Until it succeeds, leads in that window are missing — check the error and re-run the sync.
altercpa.noRunsHint: The scheduler runs every 2 minutes once an account is active.
altercpa.scopeHint_pending_only: Only leads still open on their side (processing / hold) become orders here. Ones they already approved, cancelled or trashed stay in the mirror.
altercpa.scopeHint_all: Every lead becomes an order, including ones AlterCPA has already finished. Use only for an account nobody works on their side.
